description_expanded: ABOUT INLET SANDS: Welcome to Inlet Sands, a studio condominium situated in Inlet Beach at the Inlet Sands Condominiums. Just a mere two-minute walk to the Gulf of Mexico, this unit offers a picturesque view overlooking the pool and comfortably accommodates up to 4 guests. This second-floor studio features a queen Murphy bed, twin bunk beds built into the hallway, and a private balcony affording views of the pool. The queen-sized Murphy bed discreetly tucks into the spacious living room/dining room area. The unit boasts a full-size kitchen equipped with modern stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops. Guests can enjoy a range of amenities in the complex, including beach access located a convenient 500 feet away, a swimming pool, a gazebo, and laundry facilities. Ideal for a couples retreat or a peaceful getaway, this condo provides a perfect setting for relaxation. Inlet Beach offers easy access to the charming town of Rosemary Beach, just a short bike ride away. The town features a diverse array of dining options, a cozy coffee shop, a bookstore, retail outlets, art galleries, banking facilities, a post office, a hair salon/spa, and more - all within walking distance, fostering a vibrant and livable beach community atmosphere. ABOUT THE AREA: Inlet Beach is a charming beach neighborhood located along Florida's scenic Highway 30A. Known for its stunning white sandy beaches, crystal-clear waters, and relaxed atmosphere, Inlet Beach offers a peaceful coastal getaway for visitors seeking a more laid-back vacation experience. This quaint community is characterized by its quiet residential streets lined with beautiful beach cottages and upscale vacation homes, perfect for those looking to unwind and enjoy the natural beauty of the Gulf Coast. Inlet Beach provides easy access to a variety of outdoor activities, including swimming, sunbathing, paddleboarding, kayaking, and fishing. The nearby Camp Helen State Park offers nature trails for hiking and birdwatching, while Lake Powell - one of Florida's largest coastal dune lakes - provides opportunities for boating and wildlife viewing. Visitors can also explore the neighboring beach communities of Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Beach, and Alys Beach, each offering unique shopping, dining, and entertainment options. With its pristine beaches, serene ambiance, and proximity to a wealth of recreational opportunities, Inlet Beach is a hidden gem along Highway 30A, perfect for those seeking a peaceful retreat on Florida's Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Walton Lakeshore Neighborhood beach access. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Walking distance from Rosemary Beach. * 1 minute walk to the beach. * Community pool. PARKING: * Free Parking up to 1 Vehicle. PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation. * Must Be 25 years or older. DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
